name: Featured products
description: Only the products the business has marked as featured.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/featured-products", name: "Featured products", kind: Kind.productCollection,
  description: "Only the products the business has marked as featured.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [
      Text(child: "Featured", size: FontSize.lg, weight: FontWeight.bold),
      Grid(cols: 2, gap: Space.md, children: [ForEach(items: options.products, as: "p", child: If(condition: p.is_featured, then: Box(radius: Radius.lg, background: Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), clip: true, child: Column(children: [
        Image(src: p.image_url, alt: p.name, aspectRatio: 1.33, fit: Fit.cover),
        Column(padding: Space.sm, gap: Space.xs, children: [
          Text(child: p.name, weight: FontWeight.semibold, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
          Text(child: formatMoney(p.display_price_cents), weight: FontWeight.bold),
          Button(label: "Add", size: Size.sm, fullWidth: true, onTap: AddToCart(product: p, quantity: 1))
        ])
      ]))))])
    ])
  )], options: [DataOption(name: "products", type: Product, list: true, required: true)],
)
